selection: Five additional existing Type I venues; prioritize full public advertisements and matched location evidence.
method: Read organizer/venue pages and attributed public notices; distinguish advertised games from state authorization and senior activities. Count deferred outcomes in the five.

updates.name: Pierce's Crew Foundation

before.admission: Confirm public attendance and age rules with the organizer.

published.advertised_name: Falling for Handbags · Pierce’s Crew Foundation
published.schedule: November 6, 2026: doors 5 p.m.; dinner 6 p.m.; designer purse bingo follows dinner at the Hancock Hotel. Exact first-call time is not published.
published.cost: Individual presale $65 plus ticket service fee; $75 at the door if seats remain. Table of eight $520 plus service fee. Dinner and 16 bingo rounds included.
published.admission: Age 18 and older; organizer says ID will be checked.
notes: The organizer’s ticket page gives 631 S Main St, matching this state-listed Hancock Hotel address and November 6 authorization date. This is a single event, not weekly bingo.

The 5–10 p.m. calendar span is not a bingo-start time. The organizer specifies dinner at 6 p.m., with bingo afterward. Published package prices do not guarantee availability; service fees and extra purchases may apply.

updates.finding: Organizer event and ticket pages match the state entry’s date and hotel street address.
updates.limitations: Exact first call, ticket availability and accessibility not established.

updates.name: St. John the Evangelist Church & School

before.admission: Confirm public attendance and age rules with the organizer.

published.advertised_name: Wednesday Bingo · Delphos Knights of Columbus Hall
published.schedule: Wednesday: doors 4 p.m.; early bird 6:45 p.m.; regular bingo 7 p.m.
published.admission: Venue advertises doors open to the public. Confirm age and participation rules.
notes: Knights Council 1362 advertises Wednesday bingo at 1011 Elida Road, matching the state-listed Elida Avenue venue. The state record’s license holder remains St. John the Evangelist Church & School; no separate Knights license is inferred.
The hall describes step-free entry. This is a venue-published entrance statement, not an independent accessibility inspection; ask about parking, restrooms and seating. Prices were not established.

The homepage advertises 6:45 p.m. bingo; the dedicated event page identifies that as early bird and regular bingo at 7 p.m. The separate school-campus festival row does not inherit this weekly schedule.

updates.finding: The venue homepage with current October 2026 notices and dedicated bingo page advertise the same weekly game at the state-listed physical address.
updates.limitations: Venue-published access statement only; no independent access check, full pricing or current-license conclusion.

updates.name: Newark Catholic High School

notes: The school publishes this office phone and 1 Green Wave Drive address. Its athletics page describes bingo volunteer support and gives ncaa@newarkcatholic.org for athletics inquiries.

No current public-game time was established from the official calendar or linked volunteer signup. Undated directory times are not copied to this venue, and the separate W Church Street record is not changed.

updates.finding: School identity and Green Wave address match; useful office contact established.
updates.limitations: Game days/times, prices and current attendance rules remain unconfirmed.

updates.name: Kno-Ho-Co-Ashland Community Action Commission

notes: Kno-Ho-Co’s contributed senior-center column in the September 25, 2026 Coshocton County Beacon publishes the 201 Browns Lane address and office phone. This is the center inquiry number, not a dedicated charitable-bingo line.

The column’s penny bingo, Bingocize and open-house activities are dated September 28–October 2. Those past senior activities are not converted into future sessions or the licensed Sunday/Friday game schedule. The agency website could not be fully retrieved in this review.

updates.finding: Attributed center publication corroborates the physical address and inquiry contact.
updates.limitations: Agency website retrieval was blocked; no current licensed-game advertisement established.

deferred.name: Genoa American Legion, #324 Genoa American Legion, Genoa American Legion #324, Genoa American Legion Post 324
deferred.reason: Indexed February/March notices describe first/third-Thursday games, but current organizer confirmation was not established and publisher homepage retrieval returned 403. Keep the old notice as a lead; do not add a current recurrence or fresh review date.

document_review.method: Downloaded from current parish bulletin archive; pages rendered and inspected. No corroborating weekly bingo advertisement was established; document not used as schedule evidence or republished.

public_calendar_check.result: Public iCalendar feed linked by school embed contained no Bingo-titled event. This does not prove no games exist.
